home.title: Olympiad Math & Science Coaching in Dhaka
home.description: TEMS Academy trains Classes 3–10 for olympiad math and science in Dhaka. Placed by ability, weekly problem sets, monthly benchmarks. Math Tk 2,500, Science Tk 2,700.
home.heading: Think beyond textbooks.
home.headingAccent: Train for the problems you haven’t seen.
home.lead: TEMS Academy is an offline olympiad school in Dhaka. Students are placed by ability, not by grade, and trained through weekly problem sets, laboratory work and competition pathways.

class-structure.title: Class Structure & Batches
class-structure.description: Three divisions, three tiers and ten running batches. See every TEMS batch, syllabus, session time, fee and the monthly benchmark that decides promotion.
class-structure.heading: Placed by ability,
class-structure.lead: Every student sits a diagnostic test. The result decides the division and tier, not the class on the school report. Batches are reviewed against a monthly benchmark and placements change when the evidence changes.

pathway.title: Olympiad Pathway: School to International
pathway.description: Follow each subject from school and regional rounds to the national stage and international teams. Official links and eligibility notes for every olympiad subject.
pathway.heading: From a school round
pathway.lead: Bangladesh’s olympiad routes differ by subject. These timelines show the usual progression, the official organisers to follow, and where TEMS preparation fits. Always confirm dates and eligibility with the official source.

sample-problems.title: Sample Problems by Tier
sample-problems.description: Original olympiad-style problems in mathematics, physics, chemistry and biology for Gamma, Alpha and Sigma tiers, with hints and worked solutions.
sample-problems.heading: A problem is a place
sample-problems.lead: These are original problems written for this site to show the level of work at each tier. They are not past exam questions. Try the hint before opening the solution.

resources.title: Study Guides, Books & Past Papers
resources.description: TEMS study guides, reference books and official past-paper archives for olympiad mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology and junior science.
resources.heading: A short shelf,
resources.lead: Study guides written by the academy, a small reference shelf, and direct links to the official archives. No scraped papers, no dead mirrors.

results.title: Results Archive
results.description: TEMS Academy results by year, with the competition, the students involved where names are supplied, and a source for every claim.
results.heading: Every result
results.headingAccent: we can support with a source.
results.lead: The archive lists only achievements supplied by the academy. Where a name has not been supplied, we write “TEMS student” or “TEMS delegation” rather than guessing. Years are shown only when confirmed.

faculty.title: Faculty & Mentors
faculty.description: TEMS mentors include Olympiad medalists, national-team alumni and senior academic faculty. Individual profiles are published only with consent and verified details.
faculty.heading: Mentors who have
faculty.lead: The academy describes its mentors as olympiad medalists, national-team alumni and senior academic faculty. Individual names and biographies will be added only when supplied and approved.

admissions.title: Admissions & Fees
admissions.description: Apply to TEMS Academy in four steps: application, diagnostic test, placement confirmed in writing, first class. Fees, what to bring and scholarship notes.
admissions.heading: Four steps from
admissions.lead: There is no entrance exam to pass. The diagnostic is a placement test: it tells us which division and tier fit the student now. The placement is confirmed in writing before the first class.

contact.title: Contact & Campus
contact.description: Visit TEMS Academy at House 06, Road 1/1, Shekertek Adabor, Mohammadpur-1207, Dhaka. WhatsApp, email, map and campus details.
contact.heading: Come to Adabor.
contact.lead: The campus is in Shekertek Adabor, Mohammadpur. Message before visiting so a mentor can be free to talk through placement, fees or the diagnostic.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms governing applications, placement, fees, attendance, conduct and use of the TEMS Academy website.
terms.heading: Terms & conditions.
terms.lead: These terms cover use of this website, applications, placement, fees and conduct at the academy. They are written to be read, not to hide behind.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What TEMS Academy collects through applications and enquiries, why it is collected, who processes it, and how to ask for access or deletion.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy.
privacy.lead: This site collects only what is needed to answer an application or enquiry. It does not use advertising cookies or behavioural tracking.

404.title: Page Not Found
404.description: The page you requested was not found. Return to TEMS Academy or use the main navigation.
404.heading: That page
404.lead: The link may be old or mistyped. Start from the homepage, or go straight to class structure, sample problems or admissions.
